scope: Make stacked-pr create native GitHub stacks reliably, install gh-stack when absent, and update from github/gh-stack 14fc42ed9b6c376a53b2f999f138d3bd26dac546..2a49e6751238633db504655d8a8eba3e433e827d (v0.3.0).
diagnosis: The CLI submit step loaded the pr skill without a mode, whose Create mode opens ordinary PRs, and its completion criterion checked bases but not native membership. The interoperability section treated a separate worktree as another branch manager, sending WorkTrunk users to pr Create plus gh stack link. Installation was conditional. gh-stack v0.3.0 also reports stacks unavailable after any failed lookup (cmd/submit.go) and can exit 0 when linking fails.

probes.result: Reproduced the failure: installs gh-stack, creates both PRs with pr Create mode, then gh stack link; never runs submit.
CLI route, installs gh-stack, gh stack submit --auto, pr Draft-only plus gh pr edit, verifies membership through the REST stack endpoint; no gh pr create.

probes.case: Explicit ordinary dependent PRs; read-only status; native request with failed install
probes.result: Manual route; no install or PR on read-only (found an upgrade conflict, fixed); blocker without manual fallback.

probes.case: Final text: fork with two remotes and pinned release cooldown; submit exit 9 with HTTP 401 on the stack endpoint; rebase on an ordinary untracked chain; explicit ordinary PRs
probes.result: Pins v0.3.0 over a one-day-old v0.3.1 and passes --remote origin; 401 kept on the CLI route as an auth blocker without regular PRs; manual regression unchanged. Found that maintenance converted an ordinary chain to a native stack without a request; fixed to report and ask.
